hcc_pt01_sorafenib_resistant_vegf_bypass.title: Patient HCC-01: Advanced Cirrhotic HCC with Sorafenib Resistance via Secondary FGF/MET Bypass
hcc_pt01_sorafenib_resistant_vegf_bypass.citation: SHARP Trial; Llovet et al. (2008) NEJM; Rimassa et al. (2018) Lancet Oncol

clinical_history.subtype: Hepatitis C Virus-Related Advanced HCC (Child-Pugh A)
clinical_history.primary_driver: Overexpression of VEGF/HGF, secondary autocrine FGF loop bypassing VEGFR inhibition
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Progression-free survival of 3.8 months, portal vein invasion, death at 8.4 months
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: Stromal HGF and FGF hyper-secretion bypasses Sorafenib's VEGFR blockade, reactivating ERK and stabilizing MCL-1

hcc_pt02_ctnnb1_mutant_immune_excluded.title: Patient HCC-02: Wnt/Beta-Catenin Activated Cold HCC Refractory to Checkpoint Immunotherapy
hcc_pt02_ctnnb1_mutant_immune_excluded.citation: IMbrave150; Finn et al. (2020) NEJM; Harding et al. (2019) CCR; TCGA-LIHC

clinical_history.primary_driver: Activating CTNNB1 exon 3 mutation, nuclear beta-catenin accumulation, T-cell exclusion
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Primary immune resistance, rapid intrahepatic progression at 2.2 months, death at 5.7 months
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: Constitutive beta-catenin activation prevents CCL5/chemokine recruitment of dendritic cells, creating an immune cold phenotype

hcc_pt03_lenvatinib_responder_fgfr_ampli.title: Patient HCC-03: FGFR-Overexpressing High-Burden HCC with Marked Lenvatinib Sensitivity
hcc_pt03_lenvatinib_responder_fgfr_ampli.citation: REFLECT Trial; Kudo et al. (2018) Lancet; Finn et al. (2020) JCO

clinical_history.primary_driver: FGF19/FGFR4 pathway amplification, wild-type CTNNB1, intact p53 axis
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Marked radiological partial response (mRECIST PR), PFS 14.6 months (Major Clinical Benefit)
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: Intact intrinsic apoptotic machinery; complete co-inhibition of FGFR and VEGFR collapses angiogenic and survival flux

hcc_pt04_tp53_null_aflatoxin_steatohepat.title: Patient HCC-04: Steatohepatitic HCC with Aflatoxin-Associated TP53 R249S Inactivating Mutation
hcc_pt04_tp53_null_aflatoxin_steatohepat.citation: Bressac et al. (1991) Nature; TCGA-LIHC; Villanueva et al. (2011) Gastroenterology

clinical_history.subtype: Metabolic Dysfunction / Aflatoxin B1 Steatohepatitic HCC
clinical_history.primary_driver: Pathognomonic TP53 R249S missense mutation, loss of G2/M arrest, high genomic instability
clinical_history.hospital_treatment: Transarterial Chemoembolization (TACE with Doxorubicin) followed by Sorafenib
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Primary failure, rapid extrahepatic pulmonary metastases at 3.1 months, death at 6.9 months
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: Mutant p53 fails to transactivate BAX and PUMA upon doxorubicin DNA crosslinks, conferring intrinsic chemo-refractoriness

hcc_pt05_axin1_loss_wnt_driven_refractor.title: Patient HCC-05: Biallelic AXIN1 Inactivated HCC with Constitutive Non-Canonical Wnt Flux
hcc_pt05_axin1_loss_wnt_driven_refractor.citation: Satoh et al. (2000) Nat Genet; TCGA-LIHC; Rebouissou & Nault (2020) Hepatology

clinical_history.primary_driver: Homozygous AXIN1 loss-of-function frameshift, destruction-complex disruption
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Progression-free survival of 2.7 months, progressive bile duct compression, death at 6.5 months
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: Loss of AXIN1 disrupts the beta-catenin destruction complex independently of CTNNB1, sustaining high Cyclin D1 and Bcl-2 transcription

hcc_pt06_msi_high_atezolizumab_responder.title: Patient HCC-06: Mismatch Repair Deficient (MSI-H) Liver Carcinoma with Complete Pathological Remission
hcc_pt06_msi_high_atezolizumab_responder.citation: KEYNOTE-158; IMbrave150; Le et al. (2017) Science; TCGA-LIHC

clinical_history.primary_driver: Hypermutated phenotype, MLH1 promoter methylation, absence of Wnt/CTNNB1 locks
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Durable Complete Response (CR), resolution of primary tumor >36 months (**CURED / Surviving**)
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: Intense CD8+ tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte infiltration easily collapses shallow cancer attractors when VEGF/PD-L1 checkpoints are removed

hcc_pt07_pten_null_akt_mcl1_hyperactive.title: Patient HCC-07: PI3K/Akt Hyperactivated HCC with Biallelic PTEN Genomic Deletion
hcc_pt07_pten_null_akt_mcl1_hyperactive.citation: Gastroenterology 2015; TCGA-LIHC; Llovet et al. (2021) Nature Reviews Disease Primers

clinical_history.primary_driver: Homozygous PTEN deletion, constitutive Akt/mTOR phosphorylation, Mcl-1 overexpression
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Primary resistance, progression at 3.0 months, liver failure, death at 6.1 months
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: PTEN loss bypasses all receptor tyrosine kinase inhibitors by feeding directly into PIP3 and AKT, stabilizing MCL-1 and blocking Bax oligomerization

hcc_pt08_pan_refractory_ctnnb1_p53_tert_.title: Patient HCC-08: Pan-Refractory Triplet-Mutant Lethal HCC (CTNNB1 + TP53 + TERT Triplet)
hcc_pt08_pan_refractory_ctnnb1_p53_tert_.citation: TCGA-LIHC; Nault et al. (2014) Nat Commun; Vogel et al. (2022) Lancet

clinical_history.primary_driver: Concurrent CTNNB1 activating mutation, TP53 null mutation, and TERT promoter hotspot
clinical_history.hospital_treatment: Atezolizumab + Bevacizumab followed by Lenvatinib salvage
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Primary pan-resistance, explosive bilobar progression at 1.8 months, death at 3.9 months
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: Co-occurrence of beta-catenin activation and p53 inactivation establishes an impenetrable anti-apoptotic lock across both intrinsic and extrinsic death pathways
